text:
lina: Heads-up: putting together release notes + changelog for next docs push (v0.11). Need PR coord for examples, migration guide, SDK snippets, and a short known-issues section. Anyone taking lead? ping @maya

maya: I’ll own draft & publish checklist. Need final PRs by EOD Thu. Link your PRs here. :memo:

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 -- migration guide for `embed-streaming` deprecation + snippet swaps. Needs review for copy and snippet parity.

derek: Quick callout: routing fallback behavior changed -- add a 'behavioral change' note under breaking changes. cc @janet for technical wording.

janet: Confirmed. The fallback now prefers lower-latency model variant; original behavior mentioned in infra changelog. Suggested blurb: "Routing fallback now prioritizes latency-compatible variants — may alter per-request randomness and latency distribution." Want me to paste into PR?

maya: Yes please paste and include a tiny example showing `policy: latency` vs `policy: cost`. Also check SDK sample: `rdw.generate({model:'kestrel:openai/compat'})` -- we should standardize to `rdw.text.generate(...)`.

sam: Updated snippet in PR to `rdw.text.generate(...)` and added a `// migration` comment. Also replaced broken internal anchor for 'kv-cache' with /docs/perf/caching#kv-cache

docs-bot: Checklist: 1) PR link included 2) Snippets run locally 3) Known-issues short bullets 4) Changelog entry in /changelogs/0.11.md 5) Merge window before release tag. Use `/docs release-ready` once done.

lina: Can someone sanity check the example outputs in PR? We need sample token counts and latency numbers removed -- keep generic. @maya @janet

maya: I’ll scrub numbers. Also will add a note: 'If you rely on embedding streaming, migrate to embeddings.v2 or contact SE for dedicated capacity.'

derek: :thumbsup: Also check links in docs sidebar after PR merges -- sometimes the SSG cache keeps old anchors. I'll queue a small Netlify cache bust if needed.

maya: Thanks all -- final draft by Thu 5pm PT. If you add changes after that, ping me and include a short changelog blurb for copy. :rocket:
